scenes.title:
A new supplier.
A human decision.
lines: This project helps a company review and approve new suppliers.
AI supports the review. A person makes the decision.

scenes.title:
Review evidence.
Make the decision.
lines: Here is one fictional supplier, Orion Payments.
The reviewer checks policy evidence before deciding whether to approve it.

scenes.title:
Approve once.
Save the decision.
lines: The reviewer approves this request.
The system saves the approval, the supplier record, and a local notification.

scenes.title:
The records are saved.
What if execution stops now?
lines: The records are saved, but the workflow has not confirmed completion.
A restart could repeat work unless recovery handles this safely.

scenes.title:
Stop the process.
Keep the decision.
lines: Now the demo forcibly stops the worker: the process carrying out the task.
The saved records remain in the database.

scenes.title:
Restart.
Resume the work.
lines: A replacement process picks up the same workflow.
Temporal, the workflow engine, retries the interrupted step without asking for approval again.

scenes.title:
Attempt two.
Work completed.
lines: Here is the evidence: Temporal shows attempt two, followed by completed.
The interrupted workflow has recovered.

scenes.title:
One approval. One supplier.
No duplicate records.
lines: Now check the business records: one approval, one supplier, and one local notification.
The retry created no duplicates for this case.

scenes.title:
Why recovery
works here.
lines: Temporal remembers the workflow's progress. PostgreSQL prevents the same business action from being saved twice.
AI advice cannot approve a supplier.

scenes.title: Try the workflow locally.
lines: Try it yourself: review a supplier, approve it, and reproduce the crash locally.
The default demonstration needs no paid model credentials.
